Rolex GMT-Master II “Bruce Wayne” M126710GRNR: The VSF Ultimate Jubilee Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Black & Grey Cerachrom, and the luxurious Jubilee Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF “Bruce Wayne” is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.

QF Factory Rolex Day-Date 40 Ref. 228235 “Heavy Tungsten” Edition

The elusive “Heavy Weight” version featuring a Tungsten core to achieve approx. 185 grams—the closest feel to genuine gold on the market.

Powered by Super Clone Caliber 3255

The heart of this watch is the QF Custom 3255 movement. Unlike cheaper modified movements, this mechanism is designed to replicate the correct hand stack and setting functions of the genuine Rolex caliber.

  • ✅ Power Reserve: Approx. 48-70 hours (Real-world testing suggests ~48h stable usage).
  • ✅ Functionality: Instantaneous Day & Date change at midnight (the signature “snap”).
  • ✅ Reliability: High-beat 28,800 VPH for that smooth, sweeping seconds hand motion.

Technical Specifications

THE BUILD
Tungsten Heavy Case (185g)

Standard replicas weigh ~130g. This QF version uses a Tungsten alloy core wrapped in thick 18K Rose Gold plating to reach ~185g, giving it the “heft” of real precious metal.

THE FACE
Slate Grey / Roman Dial

The “Wimbledon-style” slate grey sunburst dial features sharp, deconstructed Roman numerals. The text printing is crisp and three-dimensional.

THE BEZEL
18K RG Plated Fluted

Sharp, deeply cut flutes reflect light beautifully. The Rose Gold tone is color-matched to the Everose alloy, avoiding the “coppery” look of cheaper reps.

REFINEMENT
President Bracelet

Features the iconic semi-circular three-piece links with ceramic inserts for flexibility and a concealed Crownclasp.

🏆 Why We Chose VSF (VS Factory) for this Model?

Many clients ask: “Why not GMF (GM Factory)?”

Here is the honest truth: While GMF pioneered the Tungsten Day-Date,  VS wins in terms of total gram weight and plating tone accuracy. GMF versions often hover around 165g-170g, whereas this batch from VS hits closer to the 185g mark, making it feel significantly more substantial on the wrist.

Full Disclosure: Because the case is made of a harder Tungsten alloy, the case edges are extremely sharp and precise, but the watch is still approx. 15-20g lighter than the solid gold Genuine (which is ~205g). This 185g version is the closest physics allows us to get right now.

LIVE PREVIEW

Data Sheet

MODEL REFERENCE 228235
FACTORY / VERSION QF (Q Factory) / 185g Weighted Version
MOVEMENT Super Clone 3255 Automatic
CASE MATERIAL Tungsten Alloy Core with 18K Rose Gold Plating
CRYSTAL Sapphire with Anti-Reflective Coating on Cyclops
DIMENSIONS 40mm x 12.0mm
(Genuine spec thickness)

Common Questions about the Day-Date 40

Q: Is the gold plating durable?

A: QF uses thick microns of plating. With normal care (avoiding perfumes/chemicals on the watch), the color lasts for years. The Rose Gold tone is particularly stable.

Q: How does the weight compare to standard reps?

A: A standard steel replica weighs about 135g. This Tungsten version is ~185g. It feels significantly heavier and more luxurious in the hand, reducing the “cheap, light feel” of older replicas.

Q: Are the Day and Date functions fully operational?

A: Yes. The 3255 clone movement allows for the “double quickset” feature, meaning you can adjust the Day and Date independently via the crown, and they snap instantly at midnight.

🛡️ Our “No-Lemon” Guarantee

  • Actual QC: You will receive high-res QC photos and timegrapher videos of your specific watch before we ship.
  • Customs Safe: We use triangular shipping methods to ensure safe delivery to the US/EU/UK.

Ready to see your watch?

Rolex Submariner No-Date 124060 (41mm): The VSF Top Quality Edition

The Purist’s Choice. Powered by the exclusive VS3230 Movement with No Ghost Date Position and a true 72-hour power reserve.

Why VSF? The VS3230 Advantage

Most replicas use a generic movement with a “hidden” date click. VSF is different. We use a custom-built VS3230 designed specifically for the No-Date Submariner.

  • ✅ No Ghost Position: The crown has only two positions (Winding and Time Setting). There is no “phantom” date-setting click in the middle—just like the genuine 3230.
  • ✅ 72-Hour Power Reserve: Fully weekend-proof. Take it off Friday evening, and it will still be running on Monday morning.
  • ✅ Silent Operation: The rotor is whisper-quiet, eliminating the noisy rattle found in cheaper clones.

Technical Specifications

THE DIAL
Symmetrical Perfection

Without a date window or cyclops, the dial offers perfect symmetry. VSF replicates the deep “Jet Black” lacquer finish and the correct “Floating” text printing for a clean, uncluttered look.

CASE PROFILE
Correct 41mm Dimensions

VSF has mastered the new 41mm case geometry. It features slimmer, more tapered lugs (21mm width) compared to the older 40mm models, providing a more elegant and balanced fit on the wrist.

THE BEZEL
Platinum PVD Cerachrom

The ceramic bezel insert features recessed numerals coated in PVD Platinum. This ensures they remain bright silver and do not fade to a dull grey over time. The rotation is crisp and precise.

HANDS & LUME
Solid Center Pinion

Micro-detail alert: The hands feature a “Solid Center Pinion” cap, a sign of high-end manufacturing. Filled with Swiss Super-LumiNova for a bright, long-lasting blue glow.

Rolex Daytona 126500LN Super Clone: The 4131 Architecture

A definitive study in reverse engineering. This 1:1 Super Clone of the 2023 Cosmograph features the fully disassembled and recreated Calibre 4131 movement, housed within genuine 904L Oystersteel architecture.

Mechanical Integrity: The Calibre 4131

The justification for the investment lies inside the case. Unlike standard market replicas that rely on modified 7750 adaptors, this timepiece utilizes a standalone Super Clone 4131 movement. It mirrors the genuine Rolex architecture in weight, component interchangeability, and function.

CHRONOGRAPH SYSTEM
Vertical Clutch & Column Wheel

Ensures instantaneous chronograph start with zero hand “shudder” or jump. Pushers provide the correct mechanical resistance and click.

FINISHING
Rolex Côtes de Genève

Bridges feature the specific polished groove between bands, distinct to the 2023 generation 4131 movements.

OSCILLATOR
Paramagnetic Blue Parachrom

Features the correct blue hairspring alloy for anti-magnetic properties and stable timekeeping.

REGULATION
Factory Standard: ±10s/day

Calibrated to a tolerance of ±15s. The movement architecture allows for further professional regulation to COSC standards.

Distinguishing the 126500 Facelift

This model represents the 60th Anniversary update. Our Rolex Daytona Super Clone captures the three microscopic updates that distinguish it from the previous 116500LN:

The Travel Icon, Perfected. Featuring the legendary Dandong DD3285 Movement and the revolutionary UV-Reactive V3 Ceramic Bezel.

Forget the unreliable “modified” movements of the past. The VSF Pepsi is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong DD3285. This is not just a decoration; it is a functional masterpiece.

  • True GMT Function: Independent adjustable hour hand (jumping hour) for setting the second time zone.

2. The “Impossible” Red Ceramic

Creating a single-piece ceramic bezel with two distinct colors (Red & Blue) is notoriously difficult. Market versions often separate at the transition or use incorrect “painted” red.

The VSF V3 Solution: We use a proprietary sintering process to create a seamless transition. Under UV light, the entire bezel glows red—a definitive trait of genuine high-tech Rolex ceramic that cheap replicas cannot mimic.

description:
Rolex GMT-Master II “Bruce Wayne” M126710GRNR: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Black & Grey Cerachrom, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF “Bruce Wayne” is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Black & Grey Cerachrom: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II M126710GRNR (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Black & Grey Cerachrom (Seamless)

description:
Rolex Cosmograph Daytona M126500LN: The VSF Dandong 4130 Super Clone Edition
Motorsport Precision & Ultra-Slim Profile. Powered by the Dandong DD4130 Calibre with fully functional column-wheel chronograph and ceramic tachymeter bezel.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD4130
The pinnacle of chronograph replication. Built with a bespoke integrated 4130 movement that eliminates unnecessary plates and ticking stutter.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: Full weekend autonomous power reserve with bi-directional self-winding ball-bearing rotor.
• Column Wheel Chronograph: Crisp mechanical tactile pusher response with genuine 12-hour and 30-minute functional subdial tracking.
• True 1:1 Thickness (12.2mm): Identical case height to genuine Daytona, unlike bulky 7750 clone modifications.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Cerachrom Tachymeter: High-tech monobloc ceramic with molded tachymetric scale. Recessed numerals deposited with platinum or gold via PVD for authentic reflectivity.
• CRYSTAL - Flush-Mounted Sapphire: Optically clear synthetic sapphire crystal seated perfectly flush against the bezel rim with invisible laser-etched crown at 6 o’clock.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.2mm Ultra-Slim: Precision CNC-machined from solid 904L steel with authentic sweeping flank polish and screw-down Triplock chronograph pushers.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 3-link Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock safety clasp and 5mm Easylink extension.

• Factory / Version: VSF Dandong 4130 Super Clone

name: Rolex Super Clone Watches 11 Pepsi Gmt Master Ii M126710blro Oyster 3285 Movement
description:
Rolex GMT-Master II “Pepsi” M126710BLRO: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Red & Blue Cerachrom, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF “Pepsi” is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Red & Blue Cerachrom: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

description:
Rolex GMT-Master II 116710LN: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

description:
Rolex Cosmograph Daytona M126519LN: The VSF Dandong 4130 Super Clone Edition
Motorsport Precision & Ultra-Slim Profile. Powered by the Dandong DD4130 Calibre with fully functional column-wheel chronograph and ceramic tachymeter bezel.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD4130
The pinnacle of chronograph replication. Built with a bespoke integrated 4130 movement that eliminates unnecessary plates and ticking stutter.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: Full weekend autonomous power reserve with bi-directional self-winding ball-bearing rotor.
• Column Wheel Chronograph: Crisp mechanical tactile pusher response with genuine 12-hour and 30-minute functional subdial tracking.
• True 1:1 Thickness (12.2mm): Identical case height to genuine Daytona, unlike bulky 7750 clone modifications.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Cerachrom Tachymeter: High-tech monobloc ceramic with molded tachymetric scale. Recessed numerals deposited with platinum or gold via PVD for authentic reflectivity.
• CRYSTAL - Flush-Mounted Sapphire: Optically clear synthetic sapphire crystal seated perfectly flush against the bezel rim with invisible laser-etched crown at 6 o’clock.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.2mm Ultra-Slim: Precision CNC-machined from solid 904L steel with authentic sweeping flank polish and screw-down Triplock chronograph pushers.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 3-link Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock safety clasp and 5mm Easylink extension.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Cosmograph Daytona M126519LN
• Factory / Version: VSF Dandong 4130 Super Clone
• Movement: Dandong Calibre 4130 (Integrated Chrono, 72h)
• Bezel: Monobloc Cerachrom with Platinum PVD Tachymeter
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Solid 904L Oyster with Oysterlock Clasp
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.2 mm (True 1:1 Height)

name: Rolex Super Clone Watches 11 Batman Gmt Master Ii M126710blnr Oyster 3285 Movement
description:
Rolex GMT-Master II “Batman” M126710BLNR: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Blue & Black Cerachrom, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF “Batman” is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Blue & Black Cerachrom: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

Rolex Cosmograph Daytona M116519: The VSF Dandong 4130 Super Clone Edition
Motorsport Precision & Ultra-Slim Profile. Powered by the Dandong DD4130 Calibre with fully functional column-wheel chronograph and ceramic tachymeter bezel.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD4130
The pinnacle of chronograph replication. Built with a bespoke integrated 4130 movement that eliminates unnecessary plates and ticking stutter.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: Full weekend autonomous power reserve with bi-directional self-winding ball-bearing rotor.
• Column Wheel Chronograph: Crisp mechanical tactile pusher response with genuine 12-hour and 30-minute functional subdial tracking.
• True 1:1 Thickness (12.2mm): Identical case height to genuine Daytona, unlike bulky 7750 clone modifications.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Cerachrom Tachymeter: High-tech monobloc ceramic with molded tachymetric scale. Recessed numerals deposited with platinum or gold via PVD for authentic reflectivity.
• CRYSTAL - Flush-Mounted Sapphire: Optically clear synthetic sapphire crystal seated perfectly flush against the bezel rim with invisible laser-etched crown at 6 o’clock.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.2mm Ultra-Slim: Precision CNC-machined from solid 904L steel with authentic sweeping flank polish and screw-down Triplock chronograph pushers.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 3-link Oyster bracelet with Oysterlock safety clasp and 5mm Easylink extension.

name: Rolex Super Clone Watches 11 Gmt Master Ii Jubilee M126713grnr 3285 Movement
description:
Rolex GMT-Master II M126713GRNR: The VSF Ultimate Jubilee Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Jubilee Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Jubilee Elegance: The 5-link Jubilee bracelet offers superior comfort and a sophisticated look. VSF has refined the link articulation to ensure a silky-smooth drape on the wrist.

The Gold Standard of Ocean Tool Watches. Equipped with the legendary Dandong movement, uni-directional 120-click ceramic bezel, and Glidelock bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG CALIBRE 3135
VSF sets the benchmark with the custom-cloned Dandong Calibre 3135. Features a genuine blue Parachrom hairspring, free-sprung balance, and instantaneous date mechanism.
• 70-Hour Power Reserve: Extended autonomous running power with optimized mainspring barrel geometry.
• Glidelock Micro-Adjustment: Patented clasp adjustment system allowing 20mm of fine-tuning without any tools.
• Instantaneous Midnight Date: Date changes instantly within milliseconds at midnight without preliminary slow roll.

• THE BEZEL - Glossy Black Cerachrom: Uni-directional 120-click rotating ceramic bezel with platinum-sputtered gradations and luminescent capsule pip at 12 o’clock.

• CASE PROFILE - 41mm Refined Lugs (12.3mm): Redesigned slimmer lug profile matching genuine 41mm case proportions. Finished with satin circular brushing on top and mirror flanks.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster with Glidelock: Heavyweight solid link Oyster bracelet with authentic milled Glidelock sliding extension and laser-engraved clasp codes.

Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Black & Brown Cerachrom, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF “Root Beer” is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Black & Brown Cerachrom: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II M126711CHNR (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Black & Brown Cerachrom (Seamless)
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)
• Water Resistance: 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285

Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.

  • 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
  • True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
  • Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

Technical Specifications

THE BEZEL
Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel

The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.

CRYSTAL
VSF “Deep” Clarity

VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.

CASE PROFILE
12.1mm Thin

Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.

BRACELET
Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet

Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

Data Sheet

MODEL REFERENCE GMT-Master II 3285 (Oyster)
FACTORY / VERSION VSF Ultimate Edition
MOVEMENT Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
BEZEL Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel (Seamless)
CASE MATERIAL Solid 904L Oystersteel
BRACELET Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
CASE DIMENSIONS 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)
WATER RESISTANCE 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

The VSF Ultimate Edition Rolex GMT-Master II 3285: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition is the definitive 1:1 luxury edition. Please verify stock availability with our luxury specialists prior to checkout.

Purity, Durability, Simplicity. Equipped with the Dandong 3230 no-date movement, solid 904L steel case, and iconic lacquered dial.

name: Patek Philippe Super Clone Watches 11 5811 New Clasp
description:
Patek Philippe Nautilus 5811: The 3KF / PPF 1:1 Super Clone Edition
Haute Horlogerie Iconography. Engineered with the genuine-thickness 3KF Calibre 324 SC clone movement, satin-brushed octagonal bezel, and integrated case.

POWERED BY 3KF BESPOKE CALIBRE 324 SC / 26-330 SC
The only true 1:1 cloned Patek movement on the market. Eliminates noisy decorative rotor plates by engineering every gear, bridge, and jewel from scratch.
• True 8.3mm Ultra-Slim Case: Achieves identical genuine thickness, sitting flat and sublime on the wrist.
• 21K Gold-Plated Rotor: Heavy unidirectional winding rotor with engraved Calatrava cross and ceramic ball bearings.
• Silent Mechanical Sweep: De-coupled second wheel system ensuring completely silent and smooth 28,800 VPH sweep.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Rounded Octagonal Bezel: Vertically satin-brushed top face contrasted with mirror-beveled flanks, requiring over 55 hand-finishing operations.
• CRYSTAL - Ultra-Thin Sapphire Crystal: Precision laser-cut sapphire crystal seated tightly into the porthole bezel frame.
• CASE PROFILE - 8.3mm Ultra-Thin Profile: Two-part monobloc case construction with lateral hinges (“ears”) replicating Gérald Genta’s legendary maritime porthole design.
• BRACELET - Integrated Steel Link Bracelet: Hand-finished articulating integrated links with fold-over butterfly clasp.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Nautilus 5811
• Factory / Version: 3KF (3K Factory) / PPF 1:1 Edition
• Movement: Custom Clone Calibre 324 SC / 26-330 SC Automatic
• Bezel: Rounded Octagonal Satin Brushed Bezel with Beveled Chamfers
• Case Material: Solid 316L Stainless Steel
• Bracelet: Integrated Link Bracelet with Fold-Over Clasp
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 8.3 mm (Exact Genuine Ultra-Thin Height)
• Water Resistance: 120 Meters (Sealed Gaskets)

Haute Horlogerie Iconography. Engineered with the genuine-thickness 3KF Calibre 324 SC clone movement, satin-brushed octagonal bezel, and integrated case.

POWERED BY 3KF BESPOKE CALIBRE 324 SC / 26-330 SC
The only true 1:1 cloned Patek movement on the market. Eliminates noisy decorative rotor plates by engineering every gear, bridge, and jewel from scratch.
• True 8.3mm Ultra-Slim Case: Achieves identical genuine thickness, sitting flat and sublime on the wrist.
• 21K Gold-Plated Rotor: Heavy unidirectional winding rotor with engraved Calatrava cross and ceramic ball bearings.
• Silent Mechanical Sweep: De-coupled second wheel system ensuring completely silent and smooth 28,800 VPH sweep.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Rounded Octagonal Bezel: Vertically satin-brushed top face contrasted with mirror-beveled flanks, requiring over 55 hand-finishing operations.
• CRYSTAL - Ultra-Thin Sapphire Crystal: Precision laser-cut sapphire crystal seated tightly into the porthole bezel frame.
• CASE PROFILE - 8.3mm Ultra-Thin Profile: Two-part monobloc case construction with lateral hinges (“ears”) replicating Gérald Genta’s legendary maritime porthole design.
• BRACELET - Tropical Composite Embossed Strap: Hypoallergenic composite strap resistant to saltwater, UV radiation, and wear.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Aquanaut 5168G
• Factory / Version: 3KF (3K Factory) / PPF 1:1 Edition
• Movement: Custom Clone Calibre 324 SC / 26-330 SC Automatic
• Bezel: Rounded Octagonal Satin Brushed Bezel with Beveled Chamfers
• Case Material: Solid 316L Stainless Steel
• Bracelet: High-Performance Tropical Composite Rubber
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 8.3 mm (Exact Genuine Ultra-Thin Height)
• Water Resistance: 120 Meters (Sealed Gaskets)

name: Audemars Piguet Super Clone Watches 11 Royal Oak Selfwinding 77350st Blue Dial 34mm
description:
Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 77350ST: The APS / ZF 1:1 Super Clone Edition
Avant-Garde Architectural Haute Horlogerie. Featuring the “Grande Tapisserie” guilloché dial, custom Calibre 4302 clone, and 8 hexagonal white gold screws.

POWERED BY APS CUSTOM CALIBRE 4302 / 3120
A true clone calibre engineered with functional balance wheel bridge, authentic skeletonized rotor with AP monogram, and 70-hour power reserve.
• 70-Hour Power Reserve: Extended power reserve operating at high-beat 28,800 vibrations per hour.
• Skeletonized 22K Gold Rotor: Bespoke openworked oscillating weight with hand-chamfered edges and AP relief.
• 1:1 Case Thickness (10.4mm): Exact thickness profile matching genuine 15500 / 15400 Royal Oak.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Octagonal with 8 Hexagonal Screws: Iconic octagonal bezel held by 8 functional hexagonal screws aligned in perfect tangential symmetry.
• CRYSTAL - Anti-Reflective Sapphire Crystal: High-clarity corundum sapphire revealing the depth of the Guilloché Tapisserie squares.
• CASE PROFILE - 41mm Royal Oak Profile (10.4mm): Complex geometric case architecture with alternating satin-brushed lines and mirror-polished chamfers.
• BRACELET - Royal Oak Integrated Articulating Bracelet: Tapering links engineered with diminishing widths and AP double-folding butterfly clasp.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Royal Oak 77350ST
• Factory / Version: APS Factory / ZF Super Clone Edition
• Movement: APS Custom Clone Calibre 4302 (28,800 VPH, 70h Reserve)
• Bezel: Octagonal Brushed Steel with 8 Polished Hexagonal Screws
• Case Material: Solid 316L Stainless Steel
• Bracelet: Integrated Articulating Steel Bracelet with AP Butterfly Clasp
• Case Dimensions: 41 mm x 10.4 mm (Exact 1:1 Thickness)
• Water Resistance: 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

description:
Panerai Luminor Marina M01404: The VSF P.9010 Super Clone Edition
Italian Naval Command Heritage. Powered by the bespoke VSF cloned P.9000 / P.9010 movement, trademarked crown-lock lever, and Super-LumiNova sandwich dial.

POWERED BY VSF BESPOKE CALIBRE P.9010 / P.9000
VSF is the undisputed master of Panerai replicas. Custom-built calibre with correct 11 o’clock balance wheel position and independent jumping hour hand.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: Extended power reserve with smooth automatic bidirectional winding.
• Independent Hour Hand: Allows hour-jumping adjustment forward and backward without stopping seconds hand.
• Bespoke Balance Position: Positioned at the exact authentic angle, identical to genuine Panerai manufacture movements.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Smooth Polished Bezel: Machined bezel with crisp tactile click and deep laser-engraved minute markers.
• CRYSTAL - Thick Corundum Sapphire: 2.6mm thick scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 44mm Cushion Case (14.5mm): Signature 1950 cushion case with patented lever-activated crown protection bridge.
• BRACELET - Caoutchouc Rubber & Leather Straps: High-density accordion rubber strap engineered for diving, with trapezoidal brushed buckle.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Luminor Marina M01404
• Factory / Version: VSF (VS Factory) Ultimate Edition
• Movement: VSF Custom Calibre P.9010 / P.9000 Automatic Clone
• Bezel: Smooth Polished Steel Bezel
• Case Material: Solid 316L Stainless Steel
• Bracelet: Panerai Accordion Caoutchouc Rubber Strap with Brushed Buckle
• Case Dimensions: 44 mm x 14.5 mm (Iconic Cushion Proportions)
• Water Resistance: 300 Meters (Professional Diving Pressure Tested)

description:
Panerai GMT-Master II 1950: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II 1950 (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel (Seamless)
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)
• Water Resistance: 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

name: Panerai Super Clone Watches 11 Submersible Gmt Luna Rossa Titanio Pam01507 42mm
description:
Panerai GMT-Master II M01507: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II M01507 (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel (Seamless)
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)
• Water Resistance: 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

Panerai GMT-Master II M01323: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II M01323 (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel (Seamless)
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)
• Water Resistance: 50 Meters (Pressure Tested)

name: Panerai Super Clone Watches 11 Submersible Luna Rossa Carbotech Gmt Americas Cup Pam 01039
description:
Panerai GMT-Master II 01039: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

description:

Racing Machine on the Wrist. Crafted with real NTPT forged carbon, skeletonized automatic movement, and ultra-lightweight aerodynamic architecture.

POWERED BY SKELETONIZED HIGH-BEAT CALIBRE
Features a custom-finished skeletonized automatic movement with DLC-treated titanium baseplate and bridges.
• Bespoke Skeleton Architecture: Fully visible gear train and balance wheel oscillating at 28,800 VPH.
• Variable Geometry Rotor: High-efficiency winding rotor decorated with authentic spline screws.

description:
Breitling GMT-Master II SPU-1681: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: GMT-Master II SPU-1681 (Oyster)
• Factory / Version: VSF Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Dandong DD3285 (72h Reserve)
• Bezel: Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel (Seamless)
• Case Material: Solid 904L Oystersteel
• Bracelet: Oyster with Easylink 5mm Comfort Extension
• Case Dimensions: 40 mm x 12.1 mm (Exact Thickness)

description:
Breitling GMT-Master II SPU-1694: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

Breitling GMT-Master II SPU-1710: The VSF Ultimate Oyster Edition
Stealth, Precision, Elegance. Featuring the market-leading Dandong DD3285 Movement, the flawless Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel, and the luxurious Oyster Bracelet.

POWERED BY DANDONG DD3285
Reliability is luxury. Unlike cheaper “modified” movements, this VSF GMT-Master II is powered by the custom-engineered Dandong 3285.
• 72-Hour Power Reserve: A true weekend-proof watch with high-efficiency chronergy escapement.
• True GMT Function: Independent “Jumping Hour” hand for rapid time zone adjustment, exactly like the genuine Caliber 3285.
• Correct Hand Stack: The hour hand sits correctly relative to the GMT hand (ICHS), a critical detail for collectors.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Bi-Color Cerachrom Bezel: The defining feature of this edition. VSF has mastered the subtle transition between colored ceramic segments. The numerals are PVD platinum-coated for a sharp, enduring luster.
• CRYSTAL - VSF “Deep” Clarity: VSF is famous for its crystal quality. It offers industry-leading transparency, making the black dial pop. The cyclops features the correct “Black Hole” effect with high-grade AR coating.
• CASE PROFILE - 12.1mm Thin: Thanks to the slim DD3285 movement, VSF achieves the exact 12.1mm case thickness of the original. It slides effortlessly under a dress shirt cuff.
• BRACELET - Solid 904L Oyster Bracelet: Solid 904L Oystersteel 3-link bracelet with milled Glidelock extension clasp, offering 2mm incremental sizing adjustments.

Omega Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch SPU-1721: The VSF Co-Axial Edition
Maritime Excellence & Space Exploration Heritage. Featuring the custom VSF cloned Co-Axial Calibre, ceramic wave dial, and exhibition sapphire caseback.

POWERED BY CALIBRE 1861/3861 CLONE
VSF is undisputed #1 for Omega replicas. Features an authentic black balance wheel at 12 o’clock, Côtes de Genève in Arabesque decoration, and genuine jumping hour hand.
• True Black Balance Wheel: Positioned at the exact authentic angle, unlike cheap decorated Miyota plates.
• 55-Hour Power Reserve: Twin-barrel or single high-efficiency barrel architecture delivering continuous power.
• Exhibition Caseback Display: Sapphire display back showcasing full movement finishing with engraved red lettering.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
• THE BEZEL - Tachymeter Scale Dot-Over-90: Anodized aluminum or ceramic tachymeter bezel with historic Dot-Over-90 (DON) typography.
• CRYSTAL - Domed Scratch-Resistant Sapphire: Domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective treatment on both inside and outside surfaces for invisible glass effect.
• CASE PROFILE - 42mm Twisted Lyre Lugs (13.5mm): Signature Omega twisted lyre lugs with brushed case body and conical Helium Escape Valve at 10 o’clock.
• BRACELET - Brushed-Polished Link Bracelet: Solid link construction with push-button foldover clasp featuring innovative diver rack-and-pusher micro-adjustment.

DATA SHEET
• Model Reference: Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch SPU-1721
• Factory / Version: VSF (VS Factory) Ultimate Edition
• Movement: Super Clone Manual Chronograph Movement
• Bezel: Ceramic / Anodized Aluminum Tachymeter
• Case Material: Solid 316L Stainless Steel
• Bracelet: Solid Stainless Steel with Push-Button Micro-Adjustment

• Water Resistance: 50 Meters
